lines.text: How was basketball invented with peach baskets?
Teacher James Naismith nailed two baskets up in Springfield, Massachusetts, in eighteen ninety one.
The ball was a soccer ball. The baskets still had bottoms.
After every score, someone climbed a ladder to get the ball out.
The first game ended one to nothing. Next, why a football is called a pigskin.
